name: Baraboo
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Baraboo, WI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Baraboo, Wisconsin for 2026: Santa Express train rides, Santa Saturdays, Dells lights and Holiday Train stops.
lede: Baraboo, the Circus City, pairs Santa Saturdays at the historic Al. Ringling Theatre with Santa Express train rides in North Freedom and a Holiday Train day that reaches Portage and Wisconsin Dells.
celebrates: Downtown Baraboo decorates its streets and squares daily through December 31, and on four Saturdays Santa sits inside the Al. Ringling Theatre while free horse-drawn wagon rides circle the downtown, according to the Downtown Baraboo Christmas page. The Baraboo Children's Museum adds Stories from the North Pole and a quiet Sensory Sensitive Evening with Santa. A few miles away in North Freedom, Mid-Continent Railway Museum runs its Santa Express and an evening Holiday Flyer. Families also drive north to Wisconsin Dells for the nightly Tree of Light, and CPKC's free Holiday Train visits Portage and Wisconsin Dells on December 10.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Baraboo's holiday events, so this page leans on the host sites. The Sauk County tourism calendar shows the Country Christmas Holiday Light Parade ran on December 5, 2025, from 6 to 7 pm, and says Santa and Mrs. Claus were taking a break from the North Pole for it. The Downtown Baraboo Christmas page describes the Saturday Santa visits and wagon rides as a recurring tradition, and Mid-Continent's Santa Express is now in its 31st year.
facts: The Ringling Brothers were Baraboo natives who brought the Greatest Show on Earth back to the banks of the Baraboo River each winter, according to the Baraboo Area Chamber of Commerce. The 700-seat Al. Ringling Theatre, where Santa sits on Saturdays, was built in 1915 by Al Ringling in the style of grand French opera houses. Circus World, on the old winter quarters, shows the world's largest collection of restored historic circus wagons and reopens in February 2027.
trains: Baraboo is the best base for Christmas trains in Wisconsin. Mid-Continent Railway Museum in North Freedom runs a 55 minute, 7 mile Santa Express on November 28 and 29 and December 5, 6 and 12, plus a Santa-free Holiday Flyer on the evening of December 5. On December 10, CPKC's free Holiday Train stops in Portage at 1:15 pm and in Wisconsin Dells at 2:45 pm. Our museum guide lists Mid-Continent with kids tips and tickets.
train_links: A heritage railroad museum with a 7 mile, 55 minute ride and Santa Express weekends, listed on our museum guide.

kidfact: Baraboo's Santa sits inside a theatre built in 1915 by Al Ringling, one of the Ringling Brothers of circus fame.
faq: Downtown Baraboo decorates daily through December 31 and hosts Saturdays with Santa and free wagon rides at the Al. Ringling Theatre. Nearby, Mid-Continent Railway Museum runs Santa Express trains, and the Baraboo Children's Museum holds Stories from the North Pole. Each event is listed on its host's own website.
Where can kids meet Santa in Baraboo?

Santa sits inside the Al. Ringling Theatre on Saturdays from 11 am to 2 pm on November 28 and December 5, 12 and 19, and visits each seat on the Santa Express in North Freedom. The Baraboo Children's Museum also hosts a quiet, registered Santa evening on December 18 for children who need a calmer visit.
Are there Christmas train rides near Baraboo?

Yes. Mid-Continent Railway Museum in North Freedom runs the Santa Express on five dates through December 12 and the Holiday Flyer on December 5. CPKC's free Holiday Train also stops in Portage and Wisconsin Dells on December 10. Museum tickets are sold on the museum's own site and are best booked early.
What is the Tree of Light in Wisconsin Dells?

The Wisconsin Dells visitor bureau calls it a 55-foot silver maple wrapped in 65,000 lights on the River Walk in the 100 block of Broadway. It glows nightly from 4:30 to 11 pm, with 80 decorated trees nearby and free parking downtown, and it is free to visit.
